PR (cited in the notes as #22712): fix: remove project from cache key for project scoped credentials [closed]
Related to https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/pull/20962 and https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/pull/18388/

This PR removes the project cache key from
1. `gitRepoPaths` - This is a directory where we store cloned git repositories. Previously, the directory had repo URL + Project Name as the key. This resulted in having to re-clone already cloned repos for every project even if they are using the same git repo, which is a performance issue for large git repos.
2. `chartCachePaths` - …

charts.

For security concerns:
The actual credentials are stored separately in Kubernetes secrets, and they are project-scoped. This means that even if we remove the project from the gitRepoPaths key, the security is still maintained because each project must use its own credentials to access the repository.

i tested this case to verify
1. Project A and B share the same Repo URL, but Repo B has a bad SSH key
2. Added both Repos to ArgoCD
3. Only project A can create an application using the Repo URL from step 1. …
